mediaComposer.purpose: Focused installed Media Composer own sound-descriptor audio sampling-frequency import, getter, publication, export and failure-path audit.
mediaComposer.method: Read-only named arm64 disassembly, prior connected own physical SourceMob descriptor import receipts, explicit engine chained-vtable decoding and toolkit ordinary getter/setter slots. No application/private API or media execution.

findings.topic: Own sound-descriptor AudioSamplingRate is explicitly imported
anchors: ordinary own descriptor chain: prior Kind/Duration receipts
findings.evidence: After separately calling the FileDescriptor base importer on the same own object, the sound importer queries IAAFSoundDescriptor, obtains its typed rational AudioSamplingRate and assigns the internal audio sampling-rate state. The toolkit getter returns the stored rational through the sound descriptor property, rather than parsing a text label. This is the own file sound frequency route; track EditRate, Preface.ProjectEditRate and nominal timecode base are different facts.

findings.topic: Typed getter and setter resolve to separate audio state
anchors: toolkit sound interface point 0x2f5c60, setter/getter offsets 0x38/0x40
findings.evidence: The implementation getter copies the packed eight-byte rational property to the caller. The engine audio getter/setter use state at this+0x450, distinct from the base file rate state. The bounded getter does not perform its own positive numerator/denominator semantic validation; that does not establish arbitrary malformed property safety.

findings.topic: Failure is not a universal native blank/default policy
findings.evidence: The sound-interface query failure returns false. The sampling getter result is checked, but failure enters assertion/debug machinery; if execution continues, the importer still reads the initialized output and calls conversion/setter. There is no frequency-specific missing-to-48000 default or clean blank policy proved by this block. The base file import boolean is not checked before sound fields are imported. Bella can independently retain a valid AudioSamplingRate while Duration metadata is unusable; an explicit missing/damaged/sentinel-to-unavailable rule is Bella design rather than a claim that every native subclass/UI does that.

findings.topic: Native conversion uses internal edit-rate representation, not a raw MXF fallback rule
findings.evidence: AudioSamplingRate is passed through the same native finite-alias/internal-decimal conversion routine used by other typed rates. PCM SetRate initializes both base file rate and audio rate; later explicit AudioSamplingRate import can replace the audio frequency. PCM GetExactEditRate forwards to its audio-rate getter, while a direct base getter preserves the separately stored file clock where needed. This coupled class architecture is not permission to infer a raw absent AudioSamplingRate from FileDescriptor.SampleRate, nor to apply video aliases indiscriminately to explicit audio-frequency rationals in Bella.

findings.topic: Audio metadata publication has an audio-specific rational boundary
findings.evidence: The audio publisher first invokes the base file publisher, then obtains audio sampling rate and writes a distinct rational AudioSampleRate metadata property. If the audio getter mantissa is zero, it obtains the virtual exact descriptor rate instead before conversion. The audio-specific converter calls ClockRateToAudioClock and can use AudioClockToClockRational; its other branch uses RationalFromExactEditRate. These are native internal publication conventions, not proof of a universal wire-property fallback, perfect rational round trip or table-cell selection. Bella should preserve a usable explicit raw AudioSamplingRate rational directly.

findings.topic: Native AAF/MXF typed property export is separate
findings.evidence: The export path obtains the internal audio sampling frequency, converts it with the domain ConvertCMEditRate and calls the typed sound descriptor setter. This connects import/state/export property meaning. It is not a complete all-format GUI Sample Rate trace and does not make native internal decimal conversion a Bella storage requirement.

findings.topic: AES3 PCM shares the sound path; legacy WAVE Summary is a different route
findings.evidence: The AES3 PCM property importer delegates to PCM, whose property importer calls AudioMediaDesc. The native factory also has PCM/Sound interface map entries, but a generic factory map alone is not proof every concrete class satisfies every later PCM interface check. A separate legacy IAAFWAVEDescriptor importer calls the file base and reads/parses an embedded WAVE Summary rather than calling this sound property routine. Do not conflate that legacy AAF interface with the modern MXF WaveAudioDescriptor subclass inheriting GenericSound properties. These bounded branches do not broaden Bella release scope or create a WAVE Summary fallback requirement.

findings.topic: Frequency cannot be inferred from similarly named clocks
findings.evidence: Own FileDescriptor.SampleRate gives the physical duration count clock; AudioSamplingRate gives sound sampling frequency; track EditRate and recorded Preface.ProjectEditRate can support editing/frame-numbering context. Ordinary 48000/1 examples may make some values equal without proving interchangeability. No 48000 default, no sample-rate borrowing from another package, no channel-count multiplication and no duration/byte-size/codec decode inference are established by this native audit.

sourceFindings.detail: Own GenericSoundEssenceDescriptor.AudioSamplingRate has registered UL060e2b34010101050402030101010000 and Rational type. Rational consists of complete eight-byte numerator then denominator, both signed big-endian32. Decode exact words, not text. It is distinct from FileDescriptor.SampleRate, Track.EditRate and Preface.ProjectEditRate.

Current descriptor belongs to the essence-qualified physical SourcePackage through its complete descriptor relationship. Wave and AES3 inherit GenericSound. Current OldScanner also infers sound from AudioSamplingRate or SoundEssenceCompression property presence on unknown classes; if sound and picture classifications coexist it returns unresolved. Bella already approved exact known-class Kind mapping instead of this unknown-class inference.

For sound, projector reads only its own GenericSoundEssenceDescriptor.AudioSamplingRate and emits SampleRate if positive numerator/denominator are usable. No fallback to FileDescriptor.SampleRate, track rate, master/project editing clock, PCM coding default,48k assumption or standard-frequency whitelist occurs. It separately reads ChannelCount; channel count does not multiply sampling frequency.

sourceFindings.topic: Duration and visible Frame Rate remain independent
sourceFindings.detail: FileDescriptor.ContainerDuration is paired with its same FileDescriptor.SampleRate. AudioSamplingRate is a separate concrete frequency. Audio Duration uses a separate recorded display clock; that clock and48000Hz never become visible audio FrameRate. A missing/damaged AudioSamplingRate does not by itself erase a separately usable Duration pair, and valid AudioSamplingRate does not repair missing/damaged Duration unit-rate/count.

unique rejects unreadable/invalid or conflicting repeated decoded values. Complete known Rational with numerator>0 and denominator>0 is required to emit the rate; zero/negative/zero-divisor do not become48k or a valid zero frequency. MultipleDescriptor projection can emit several child values; resolver compares positive rate fractions exactly by64-bit cross-products and blanks incompatible equal-rank alternatives. Do not conflate that OldScanner traversal with Bella approving all interleaved variants.

Current SampleRate source priority is usable MXF/OMF before MDB. Audio missing usable SampleRate is one required-metadata reason to read a header. This is current OldScanner behavior. Bella audio SampleRate cross-source priorities/header-open conditions remain later decisions; do not automatically import the specific approved FrameRate fallback rule into this field.

Adapter copies selected exact numerator/denominator to row.sampleRateRatio, preserving unreduced fractions. It separately derives qRound(ratio.value()) into whole-Hz int sampleRate, or0 when unavailable. This integer is a compatibility duplicate, not the authoritative preserved value. The table/sorting/CSV all prefer the exact ratio when valid, so rounding that int normally does not cause displayed or sorted fractional frequency loss.

sourceFindings.topic: Late kHz labels, table and CSV
sourceFindings.detail: sampleRateHz() uses double(numerator)/denominator when the exact pair is valid, otherwise nonnegative compatibility int. sampleRateDisplay() divides Hz by1000 and formats general notation with10 significant digits plus kHz. No stored per-row SampleRate label is created by the adapter. Unknown/nonpositive values show blank. Table and CSV call that shared helper, e.g.48kHz,44.1kHz,96kHz. The current helper itself does not gate on Kind; normal projections supply SampleRate only for audio. Bella already requires blank SampleRate for video.

SampleRate sorting directly compares sampleRateHz() doubles, never parses the formatted kHz label or uses the rounded whole-Hz compatibility int when an exact ratio exists. Table UserRole exposes the same positive numeric Hz. Thus current source retains exact ratio and avoids label-round-trip sorting, though comparison still converts to floating point. Bella can share a small exact rational comparison helper; qint32 positive factors fit exact qint64 cross-products. Generic uncommon-frequency label precision remains a presentation choice.

currentMediaMuster.plainSummary: Current own sound descriptor AudioSamplingRate is the concrete frequency source. Positive exact rational survives in sampleRateRatio; rounded whole-Hz compatibility integer is secondary. Table/CSV use late kHz labels from the ratio; sorting uses numeric frequency, not parsed label. No clock/default fallback is supplied. This good source separation can be re-expressed in fresh small Bella helpers.

proposal.status: Proposed MXF source/retention rule, not approved or implemented.
proposal.source: Already qualified physical file own supported GenericSound/WaveAudio/AES3Audio descriptor GenericSoundEssenceDescriptor.AudioSamplingRate. Keep source property name AudioSamplingRate internally; audio column heading Sample Rate.
proposal.representation: Known complete eight-byte big-endian Rational, signed32 numerator then denominator, both positive. Preserve original words and legitimate uncommon fractions. Numeric frequency, not text.
proposal.unavailable: Missing, damaged, conflicting, unsupported, unsafe ownership or distinguished0/1 supplies no MXF audio frequency. Retain physical file and independent facts; blank if no eligible source supplies it. No invented48k default, whitelist or substitute FileDescriptor.SampleRate/track/project clock.
proposal.independence: Duration physical unit rate, audio editing/display clock, video Frame Rate and concrete audio frequency retain separate meanings. No channel-count multiplication or MDB video NTSC alias interpretation. Video Sample Rate and audio Frame Rate stay blank.
proposal.retention: One compact exact frequency record and needed availability. Reuse C++17/Qt fixed-width numeric/comparison/endian helpers. Derive any compatibility integer at the boundary; no permanent whole-Hz source duplicate or retained property graph. Release temporary header/reference storage.
proposal.displayAndSort: Generate kHz labels from frequency at display time, preserving familiar48kHz/44.1kHz/96kHz behavior. Sort numerically; shared exact fraction comparison can be used. Uncommon fractional label precision remains prior presentation follow-up.
proposal.readAndPriorityBoundary: Extract during an independently required header parse. No new dependency, essence decode or frequency-only consistency walk. Do not infer audio source precedence/read triggers from the separately approved FrameRate-specific rule; final table remains deferred.
